Centralised and secure access of Tally, anytime, anywhere

Tally on Cloud takes your offline Tally software to the cloud. You can reach your Tally data from anywhere, at any time and on any device, with a low-maintenance, economical way of running TallyPrime.

With Tally on Cloud you avoid many of the costs of running Tally in-house, such as server hardware, backup and data maintenance, and other IT overheads. We look after your IT requirements while you run your business.

Seerweb Cloud services go beyond Tally. We can also provide other essential software such as email and MS Office.

Talk to us

Three ways to reach Tally remotely

Each option suits a different need. Here is how they differ.

Full access

Tally on Cloud

Use TallyPrime completely, from anywhere and at any time.

  • Complete use of TallyPrime
  • Managed hosting, backup and security
  • Suits teams who work from multiple places
Remote access

Remote access

View reports and check your position while you are away from the office.

  • Needs a valid TSS subscription
  • The remote PC needs the same Tally release as your office PC and a good internet connection
  • Useful for checking receivables or stock before a decision, or during an audit
  • Not full-fledged use, and only one person can connect remotely
View reports

Browser report

See your reports in a web browser on any device.

  • Needs a valid TSS subscription and an internet connection
  • Only the registered email ID and password can open your data
  • You control what can be viewed
  • For anything beyond viewing, choose Tally on Cloud

Need more than the default Tally features? Tally on Cloud lets you use TallyPrime completely, from anywhere and at any time.
